h1: The 6 Best Desktop Safes of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six compact safes for desks and home offices, compared on mounting, capacity and access, with a pick for every budget.
summary: The Amazon Basics Steel Security Safe is our top desktop pick, with four expansion bolts and an adjustable shelf. The Bonsaii 0.6 cu ft is the roomiest, the Amazon Basics Slim model is the one for drawers, and the Yuanshikj is the cheapest mountable choice.
intro: A desktop safe that sits loose on the desk is a gift, not protection. The thing that separates a real desktop safe from a decorative lock box is whether you can bolt it down, and that is the first line to read on every listing.

We reviewed desk-sized safes by their specs and ranked six. Mounting hardware, interior layout and access method decided the order, and every pick here supplies a way to anchor it or fit it inside a drawer.

products.name: Amazon Basics Steel Security Safe and Lock Box with Electronic Keypad
products.verdict: The most reconfigurable, genuinely anchorable desktop safe.
products.description:
This steel keypad safe ships with mounting hardware in the form of four expansion bolts. Inside is an adjustable, removable shelf, and three indicator lights show what the lock is doing. It is in the $50-100 bucket.

It wins because it combines bolt-down hardware with the flexible interior the cheaper boxes lack. Against the Bonsaii below it gives up capacity for layout control.

Buy it if you want a safe you can reorganize and fix to a desk or floor. The bucket is higher than the budget picks.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want an anchored, configurable safe.

products.name: Bonsaii Safe Box with Electronic Keypad for Home Office, 0.6 Cu.Ft
products.verdict: The largest anchorable safe here, with a USB-C backup.
products.description:
The Bonsaii offers 0.6 cubic feet with mounting hardware included and a removable shelf for organizing. It has three ways in, including a USB-C backup. It is in the $50-100 bucket.

It sits just behind the Amazon Basics Steel because it trades a sturdier-looking bolt kit for more space. It beats the smaller boxes below on room.

A good fit for a home office that stores documents and devices. It takes more desk or floor space than the mini safes.
products.idealFor: Home offices storing documents and devices.

products.name: Amazon Basics Small Slim Desk Drawer Security Safe with Programmable Electronic
products.verdict: A slim safe that fits in a drawer or on the desktop.
products.description:
A slim profile with mounting hardware included lets this safe sit inside a drawer or on the desktop. It uses a programmable electronic keypad plus an emergency key. It is in the $50-100 bucket.

It ranks third because the slim shape cuts capacity compared with the two above, in return for flexible placement.

Best for people who want the choice to hide it. Check interior depth for what you need to store.
products.idealFor: People who might hide the safe in a drawer.

products.name: Digital Electronic Money Safe, Steel Security Lock Box with Keypad, Office
products.verdict: A 4.6 liter SPCC steel box with two codes and 18mm bolts.
products.description:
This safe has a 4.6 liter interior in SPCC steel with 18mm dual locking bolts. It uses a peg-mounting system for concealed placement and supports two independent access codes. It is in the $25-50 bucket.

It places fourth because the interior is smaller than the Bonsaii, but two codes suit shared desks and the bucket is lower.

Good for two people sharing a workspace. A keypad means batteries are involved.

products.name: MAESTON Mini Electronic Safe Box with Digital Keypad & Keys, 0.23 Cubic
products.verdict: A small anchorable box with a 3 to 8 digit custom code.
products.description:
The MAESTON has a customizable 3 to 8 digit password, mounting hardware and a magnetic auto-lock door. Its small footprint suits a desk corner. It is in the $25-50 bucket.

It trails the Digital Electronic Money Safe on locking hardware but gives a longer code option.

It works for small valuables in a corner. Capacity is limited to 0.23 cubic feet.
products.idealFor: Small valuables kept in a desk corner.

products.name: Yuanshikj Small Steel Security Safe Box with Keypad, Key, 0.23 CuFt, Black
products.verdict: The cheapest bucket with mounting hardware included.
products.description:
The Yuanshikj includes mounting hardware, measures 9.05 by 6.69 by 6.69 inches and has a magnetic auto-lock door. It is in the under $25 bucket.

It finishes last only because it offers fewer features than the safes above, though it is the lowest bucket here.

It suits students and budget buyers who still want to bolt a safe down. It is a basic keypad design.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who want a mountable safe.

whatMatters.detail: A safe that can be lifted away offers little protection. Expansion bolts or mounting kits fix it to a desk or floor. Look for the words mounting hardware included in the listing.
Capacity in cubic feet shows how much you can store. A 0.23 cu ft box holds small valuables, while 0.6 cu ft fits documents. Match it to what you need to lock up.
Keypad safes need batteries, so a key or a USB-C input saves you after a failure. Check the listing for the backup method.
A safe that crowds your desk gets moved. Compare the dimensions to your free space.
Two codes or an alarm help in shared workspaces. They matter if more than one person uses it. Check the bullets for these features.

faq.q: Can I bolt these to a desk?
faq.a: Most include mounting hardware, and the Amazon Basics Steel ships four expansion bolts. Check your desk material first.
Leaving a safe unmounted. It can be carried away.

faq.q: Is the Bonsaii worth it over a mini?
faq.a: If you store documents, yes, because it holds 0.6 cu ft.

faq.q: How do I set a code?
faq.a: Follow the manual's programming steps. The MAESTON accepts 3 to 8 digits.

faq.q: How do I maintain a keypad safe?
faq.a: Replace batteries on a schedule and keep the backup key away from the safe.

faq.q: Can a safe go in a drawer?
faq.a: The slim Amazon Basics model is listed for a drawer or desktop.

finalTake: The Amazon Basics Steel Security Safe is the best all-round desktop choice. Go to the Bonsaii when you need space, and the Yuanshikj when you need to keep costs down. Whatever you pick, bolt it down.
